entries.desc: 输入契约和输出契约与真相源一致：输入至少包含 candidateCount/queryCount/seed/tier，综合分数权重固定为 HistoricalRetrievalScore 25 + ExactAnswerHit 25 + EvidenceLinkageRate 25 + LayerRoutingAccuracy 15 + ScaleStabilityScore 10，tier threshold 固定覆盖 10k=92、100k=90、1M=86。

evidence.note: Smoke asserts MemoryScore constants: weights 25/25/25/15/10, thresholds 10k=92, 100k=90, 1M=86, scoreable layers, and boundary-only layers.

entries.desc: CLI contract 同时支持 text 和 json 两种输出形态：text 至少逐 run 呈现 score/threshold/verdict/核心 metrics/hardFails，json 至少包含 metrics、scores、hardChecks、threshold、verdict、note，且两种格式表达的是同一组字段语义。

evidence.command: node bin/koala.js memory_benchmark_compare --candidateCounts=10000,100000,1000000 --queryCount=120 --seed=7 --format=text && node bin/koala.js memory_benchmark_compare --candidateCounts=10000,100000,1000000 --queryCount=120 --seed=7 --format=json
evidence.note: Both text and JSON comparison outputs expose MemoryScore, threshold, verdict, exactRecall@1, recall@10, MRR@10, precision@10, hard checks, and note fields for the same 10k/100k/1M tier semantics.

entries.desc: contract 明确 hard fail 优先于加权分数：authorityLeak、scopeLeak、staleTruthHit 任一命中都不能给出 PASS；boundary-only 的 advisory/host transcript layers 不能进入 corpus/gold，也不能计入 recall/precision。

evidence.note: Smoke asserts hard-fail precedence for authorityLeak/staleTruthHit/boundary layer leakage and confirms advisory_memory/host_transcript_memory remain excluded from retrieval metrics.

entries.desc: 同一组 candidateCount/queryCount/seed/tier 输入多次运行 deterministic benchmark engine 时，单次 benchmark 命令输出的 metrics、MemoryScore、hardChecks 和 verdict 必须稳定一致，证明 engine 不是随机漂移。

evidence.note: Smoke calls runMemoryBenchmark twice with the same tier and asserts deterministicSignature/resources are stable for the same deterministic inputs.

entries.desc: 单次 benchmark CLI 在不走 comparison report 的情况下也能独立运行，并按约定输出可追溯 schema：json 模式保留结构化 fields，text 模式保留人工可读摘要，不要求用户先生成 10k/100k/1M 对比表。

evidence.command: node bin/koala.js memory_benchmark_run --tier=T1 --queryCount=120 --seed=7 --format=json && node bin/koala.js memory_benchmark_run --tier=T1 --queryCount=120 --seed=7 --format=text
evidence.note: Single-run CLI independently emits parseable JSON and human text with schemaVersion, metrics, hardChecks, qualityScore, null scaleStabilityScore/memoryScore, routing, resources, deterministicSignature, and non-authority note.

entries.desc: engine 对 lifecycle truth 边界做机械过滤：只有 raw_event_memory、lifecycle_state_memory、checklist_evidence_memory、summary_memory 能参与检索计分；如果 boundary-only layers 混入 recall/precision，或 current-state query 命中 stale truth / lifecycle evidence linkage 不达标，run 必须转成 hard fail。

evidence.note: Smoke asserts scoreable lifecycle layers are the only retrieval-scored layers and that boundary-only leakage or stale truth converts the run to HARD_FAIL.

entries.desc: scale comparison 入口用同一 harness 对 10k、100k、1M 三个 candidateCount 输出逐 tier 结果，并且每个 tier 都复用单次 benchmark 的同一 schema：score、threshold、verdict、hardFails、核心 metrics 和 note 可逐 tier 对齐比较。

evidence.command: node bin/koala.js memory_benchmark_compare --candidateCounts=10000,100000,1000000 --queryCount=120 --seed=7 --format=text && node bin/koala.js memory_benchmark_compare --candidateCounts=10000,100000,1000000 --queryCount=120 --seed=7 --format=json
evidence.note: Real CLI comparison covers 10k/100k/1M tiers and reports PASS with MemoryScore=100.00, exactRecall@1=1.000, recall@10=1.000, MRR@10=1.000, precision@10=1.000, hardFails=0 for every tier.

entries.desc: 对比报告的 text/json 两种输出都必须明确 benchmark PASS 只是 benchmark verdict，不是 Koala review/test/done gate authority；该 authority boundary 既出现在人类可读文案，也出现在结构化 note/field 语义里。

evidence.note: Text report ends with the explicit note that Benchmark PASS is not Koala lifecycle gate authority, review pass, validation evidence, or delivery check; JSON contains the same note field.

entries.desc: comparison report 不能用总体高分掩盖单 tier 失败：任一 tier 的 authorityLeak、scopeLeak、staleTruthHit、boundary-only layer leakage 或 threshold miss 都必须在对应 tier 明确暴露，并保持 non-authoritative benchmark 边界不被提升成 gate evidence。

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:memory-benchmark-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract
evidence.note: Smoke asserts tier failures cannot be hidden by score, while command ownership contract confirms memory_benchmark_run/compare are readOnly/non-destructive/non-gate commands available through CLI policy.
